public.title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
public.description: Evaluate a valid reverse Polish expression using integers and the binary operators +, -, *, /. Each operator consumes the two previous stack values in left-then-right order. Integer division truncates toward zero. There are 1 to 200 tokens; division by zero never occurs. All literals and intermediate results are signed 32-bit integers.
hints: Operators take the right operand from the top of the stack.
Use truncation toward zero for negative quotients.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Push numeric literals and replace operand pairs with each operator result. O(token count) time and space.
